entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, thanks for calling VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hello, Charlie. I... I was hoping to make a return. It's a jersey I bought a couple of months ago, and I just feel awful about it.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. I've been a loyal customer for so long, and I've never had to return anything. It's just... things are a bit tight right now.

I appreciate you providing that. One moment while I pull up the details... Okay, I see the ProFit Jersey here, delivered on September 28th. To make sure I'm helping correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Oh, it's a preference, I guess. It's the wrong size. I finally got around to trying it on for a ride and it's just way too tight in the arms. I had wanted to do an exchange, but I never got around to it, and now I just... I could really use the money back for gifts.
I completely understand, and I'm sorry to hear the fit wasn't right for you. Let me just review the return eligibility for this item. Please hold.
Okay, thanks for your patience. I've checked our policy, and it looks like you are still within our 90-day return window. I can definitely process a full refund for you.
You can? Oh, that's such a relief! I was so worried I was too late. Thank you so much, really.

Of course. I'm happy we could get this sorted out. I have just initiated that return for you. You should receive an email shortly with a prepaid shipping label to send the jersey back to us. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed to your original form of payment.
That's wonderful news. You've really helped me out today, Charlie.
It was my pleasure. Was there anything else I could assist with?
No, that was everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
